capabilities: : Manage vault data via local file transfer
extras: Desktop-only plugin; interface is in Chinese; optional Git transport requires system Git installation.
problem: Users need a way to transfer and synchronize their entire Obsidian vault between different computers without relying on network connectivity or cloud services.
summary: Locally Save allows users to move and synchronize their Obsidian vault between different machines using local file copies and diff bundles without needing network access.
